No existing S1894 node/queue entry — this is a fresh package. I'll append an AUDIT_LEDGER entry (append-only) and send the parent the result. I won't invent new coord files (out of scope, parent coordinates); I'll note it.

Let me write the ledger entry in the same style. Keep it concise but complete:

```
## 2026-11-01 S1894: D5 large-image input on the actual curve E'/F'

- Question: prove the SL_2 large-image input S1725ImageContainsSL2 l for the
  actual S1720 curve E'/F' (equivalently the D5 clause SourceTorsionClause l
  for that curve), or pin the exact first missing.
- Result: MISSING, with the exact gap now reduced and machine-checked.  S1725
  had already built the paper's Definition 3.1(c) clause for E'/F'
  conditionally on S1725ImageContainsSL2 l; S1894 proves that
  (i) SL_2(F_l) is literally det.ker inside GL_2(F_l) (S1894SL2_eq_detKer),
  (ii) change of basis conjugates the matrix representation, hence the
  containment is basis independent, for any actual curve
  (S1894GenImageTail_congr),
  (iii) S1725ImageContainsSL2 l  <=>  S1725RankTwoBasisGap l  and the
  basis-free large-image input (S1894ImageContainsSL2_iff), and
  (iv) the first missing input is literally the frozen
  SerreStyleLargeImageStatement E' l (S1894ExactMissing_iff_serre).
  The "exists a basis" component of the D5 condition is therefore only the
  known open rank-two freeness card (equivalently finrank = 2 given
  finiteness, S1894RankTwoBasisGap_iff_finrank), not a second gap.
- Unchanged arithmetic side (all unconditional for E'/F', as re-exported):
  Torsion23Rational E' (S1721/S1724), mu_6 carrier and primitive-root label
  (S1725), l-coprimality at the selected bad place for every l >= 5 (place
  above 7 at l = 5, above 5 otherwise, S1725), split multiplicative reduction
  (S1720), representation surjective onto its range by construction.
  In particular the l = 5 residue-characteristic selection issue of the
  S1687 interface disappears at the S1720/S1725 interface.
- What is still missing (no fake, no axiom): the Serre-style large-image
  statement for the actual mod-l image of E'/F' (plus rank-two freeness of
  E'[l]).  A grep of the whole tree shows SerreStyleLargeImageStatement and
  RankTwoTorsionBasisGap occur only as definitions/docstrings, never as a
  proved theorem, so no existing arithmetic result (nine-point injection,
  odd residue, split reduction, torsion base change, degree bound) yields it.
- Evidence: tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1894D5LargeImageActual.lean, 32111 bytes,
  SHA256 19CC8AA9A8F25EAA237B47B7A9DF2C294D1E1DB4621073E1EEE8469AE01E3AF0;
  EXIT=0; olean 495440 bytes SHA256
  ED80B9D1F22B58A48501A9EC05729B57F8CB8F0163EFBC0166B7F151859607F6; axioms
  propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only, no sorryAx, no new axiom.
```

Wait — the file bytes: I edited the docstring after building, so the file size/SHA changed after the last hash computation? Let me re-check: I computed SHA 19CC8... after the docstring/axioms edit? Sequence: (1) integrated generic section, compiled (writing olean); (2) edited docstring + axiom list; (3) final compile EXIT=0 with olean; (4) hash command → SHA 19CC8AA9... 32111 bytes, LastWriteTime 13:04:34, olean mtime 13:05:43. Yes, the hash was computed after all edits (13:04 edit vs 13:05 build). ✓ So SHA 19CC8... is current. Let me double-check by recomputing (cheap) at the end.

Note: the olean at `.lake/build/lib/lean/...` was written at 13:05:43 and hash ED80B9D1... ✓ (computed after) ✓.

Also, there's a stray olean in the source dir (from earlier `lake env lean` runs without -o)? Let me check `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1894D5LargeImageActual.olean` — if present, it's harmless but let me check and note. Actually `lake env lean file.lean` writes .olean next to the source? I believe Lean writes the olean to the source directory by default. Let me check and if present, leave it (other S-files may have them too?). Hmm, earlier listing of `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/*.lean` — none of these have .olean next to them (they're in .lake). If I created a stray olean in the source dir, maybe I should remove it for cleanliness. But wait — earlier the probe import failed with "object file .lake/build/... does not exist", implying Lean looked in the build dir only (LEAN_PATH). And the first compile of my file with `lake env lean` (no -o) — where did it write the olean? Let me check the source dir.

Then let me append the ledger entry, verify final hashes, and report.

  conditionally on S1725ImageContainsSL2 l.  S1894 proves:

  (ii) a change of rank-two basis conjugates the matrix representation, hence
  the containment SL_2 <= im rho_{l,b} is independent of the basis, for an
  arbitrary actual punctured elliptic curve (S1894GenImageTail_congr), so the
  "exists a basis" quantifier carries no extra content;

  reduction, torsion base change, degree bound) yields the image statement,

  EXIT=0; olean 495440 bytes SHA256
  ED80B9D1F22B58A48501A9EC05729B57F8CB8F0163EFBC0166B7F151859607F6; axioms
  propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only, no sorryAx, no new axiom.
`;
const cur = await tools.read({ file_path: "D:\\lean\\AUDIT_LEDGER.md" });
const prev = cur.lines.map(l=>l.text).join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "D:\\lean\\AUDIT_LEDGER.md", content: prev.replace(/\s*$/,"") + "\n" + ledger });
const r = await tools.pwsh({
  description: "Verify ledger append and final hashes",
  command: `Get-Content D:\\lean\\AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 6
Write-Output '--- final hash ---'
Get-FileHash D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1894D5LargeImageActual.lean -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash
Get-FileHash D:\\lean\\.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1894D5LargeImageActual.olean -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash
Select-String -Path D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1894D5LargeImageActual.lean -Pattern 'sorry|axiom |admit' | Select-Object -First 5`,
  workdir: "D:\\lean", timeoutMs: 300000,
});
console.log(r.kind==='foreground'? r.stdout.text : JSON.stringify(r));", "description": "Append audit ledger entry and verify hashes"}
